name: Fudan University School of Management (Fudan International MBA)

program.format: 2-year full-time, English-taught (Fudan IMBA, MIT Sloan partnership), September intake

tuition_total.cohort: Fudan IMBA entry (intake year not stated on page)
tuition_total.note: Page states 'Fudan IMBA entry: CNY 369,800' (part-time Chinese-taught Fudan MBA: CNY 539,800). Instalments not stated.

mandatory_fees_total.note: No other mandatory fee published on the fees page.

living_budget_total.note: No living budget published. On-campus dormitory fees are given per person per day in images dated 2018 (not reused as current); water and electricity extra.

scholarship.note: Entry scholarships (Diversity, Entrepreneurship, Excellence, Women Leadership, Social Responsibility, Young Talent), amounts not stated. GMAT scholarships: 750+ (Focus 715+) 100% of tuition; 710-750 (665-715) 50%; 680-710 (625-665) 30%; 650-680 (595-625) RMB 40,000. Xing Quan Belt and Road Scholarship RMB 250,000 over two years for 2 students/year. Share of students aided not published.

base_salary.note: The 2025 report publishes no salary figure.

by_industry.sub: Financial Services (mainly asset management, VC/PE, securities/investment banking)

by_geography.sub: Other cities in China (Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Suzhou, Wuxi)
Other countries (Canada, Netherlands, Peru, Germany, Malaysia, Ivory Coast, South Korea)

employment.notes: Only top-5 industries and top-5 functions are published. Other figures: average 1.7 job offers; 21.8% entrepreneurship/family/self-owned business; 80.4% career switch. Employer types: private 66.7%, wholly foreign-owned 21.6%, state-owned 9.7%, government/non-profit 2.0%. Response rate and number of graduates not stated; figures 'based on responses received ... in the three months after graduation'. 'Hired at least 2' marked with hires=2 as a floor.

profile.note: Latest class profile on the IMBA site is Class of 2023 (93 enrolled); international share not published.

notes: Source PDF saved as research/sources/fudan-employment-report-2025.pdf. No salary published by the school: excluded from ROI ranking unless a salary is found.
